dependant.rule: Run cargo tree --target all --workspace --all-features, and read a crate missing there as missing from every build.

owner: No single system owns it: it describes the feature resolution that any Cargo workspace exhibits, and Cargo is third-party.
theory: It names no type, function or wire format of one repository: it holds for any dependency graph whose edges are guarded by features closed under Horn rules (PROOF-POLICY §1).
